name: DiscardWorkingCopy
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork; deletes only one recoverable UI row plus metadata-only command/audit evidence
guards: row belongs to authenticated local user
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; committed replay returns prior result; a new command against absent row returns UI_WORKING_COPY_NOT_FOUND
receipt_order: revalidate -> insert command_receipt -> delete row -> metadata-only audit/result -> commit
revision_effects: none outside deleted UI recovery row
